title: SCS-001 — Switch pipeline from mock to live mode + lift production pause

tasks.description: Surgical edit to ecosystem.config.js: in the scs001-pipeline entry (line ~770), change args: process.env.SCS_MODE || 'mock' to args: 'live'. Also add SCS_MODE: 'live' to the env block. Then run: pm2 reload ecosystem.config.js --only scs001-pipeline --update-env && pm2 save.
